crossSets.meaning: Common fennel and giant fennel: the species of this collection that people call fennel. No family or genus holds just these two. NCBI Taxonomy places common fennel (filed there as Anethum foeniculum) in tribe Apieae, with dill and celery, and Ferula in tribe Scandiceae, with carrot. The smallest botanical group holding both is subfamily Apioideae, which also holds carrot, celery, coriander and dill.
